related.reason_vi: Quản lý bí mật và băm mật khẩu là hai việc bảo mật cụ thể mà DevSecOps kiểm tra.

claims.evidence: OWASP DevSecOps Guideline and Secrets Management Cheat Sheet read from local clones; threat modeling and the mapping of techniques to stages are the author's arrangement.

claims.claim_vi: The OWASP DevSecOps Guideline aims to detect security issues (by design or application vulnerability) as early as possible and to promote a shift-left security culture.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of the OWASP repository.

claims.claim_vi: The guideline lists pre-commit secrets management, SCA, SAST, IaC scanning (Terraform, Helm), software supply-chain security (SBOM, artifact signing), IAST, DAST, compliance and policy as code, and security gates that block risky builds and releases.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of the OWASP repository.

claims.claim_vi: CI/CD tools often expand the attack surface, so security controls are needed around them.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of the OWASP repository.

claims.claim_vi: Secrets management includes centralised storage, auditing and rotation of secrets to prevent leaks and compromise.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of the OWASP repository.

claims.claim_vi: Threat modeling, continuous monitoring, container security, QA integration and collaboration are key DevSecOps concepts; placing each at a pipeline stage is the author's arrangement.
claims.verified_by: Carried from the source as general description; not independently checked.

design_notes_vi: Sáu chặng của đường ống, mỗi chặng một việc; thẻ cuối nói chính đường ống là mục tiêu. Không có mũi tên sau chặng cuối. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source is an unordered list of ten concepts with no explanation; the lesson places the technical ones at pipeline stages and names the two cultural ones (QA integration, collaboration) separately.
Source does not mention that the CI/CD pipeline itself is an attack surface; the lesson adds it from the OWASP guideline.
